'''Emen Rooshan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. One of the greediest of the [[Rooshan]] clan who ran the small [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Lohema]], he grew so resentful of the nearby city of [[Joreikna]] that he hired [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] some of the ruling clan of that city, the [[Ku'rys]].<ref name="GatORW" />
